messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@aeonhealth.com>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@aeonhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: AEON Health: follow-up on SSO / KMS / log retention & deployment recommendation

Hi Maya / Tom —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps so we can align on whether Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private is the right fit for AEON: 

Recap / constraints you mentioned:
- SSO: Must integrate with Okta (SAML + SCIM provisioning), enforce MFA and have SCIM for user provisioning.
- KMS/HSM: Keys must be customer-controlled; prefer HSM-backed KMS (Azure Key Vault or AWS CloudHSM).
- Logging: Audit logs retained for 7 years for model inference metadata; raw request logs must be segregated and purged according to policy.
- Data residency: All inference traffic must remain in us-west-2.
- Procurement: you requested pricing ranges and a PoC scope to validate latency and cost.

Initial recommendation (based on constraints):
- Private (VPC/on-prem) is the conservative recommendation if AEON requires HSM-backed key control + 7-year audit log retention inside your environment.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity) can meet strict SSO + regional constraints and is a faster path if one of the following is acceptable: Redwood-managed KMS with customer key import OR you accept a hybrid where KMS is customer-managed in AWS and we route to Dedicated in your VPC.

Next steps I propose:
1) I attached a short security checklist (Redwood-Security-Checklist-AEON_v2.pdf) that maps each control to our options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Could you confirm which rows are "hard requirements" vs "nice-to-have"?
2) Share a point contact in security/compliance so we can line up a 30–45 minute technical call to review KMS/HSM and logging architecture (suggested: next Tue or Wed).
3) If Procurement is ready, I can drop a PoC scope (attached) and an estimate for Dedicated vs Private monthly run rate.

If helpful, I can sketch two mutually exclusive MUTUAL ACTION PLANS: one for a Dedicated PoC (4 weeks) and one for a Private POC (6–8 weeks).

Thanks — I’ll hold on pricing until we confirm the KMS/HSM gating items.

Best,
Ben Carter

Subject: Re: AEON Health: follow-up on SSO / KMS / log retention & deployment recommendation

Ben — thanks for the recap and the checklist. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SSO (Okta): hard requirement. We need SAML + automated SCIM provisioning for service accounts and deprovisioning tied to HR system.
2) KMS/HSM: hard requirement to have customer-controlled keys in an HSM. We prefer AWS CloudHSM but could consider Azure confidential VM if you support it.
3) Logging & retention: hard requirement for 7 years. Logs must be write-once in our audit S3 bucket (WORM), with limited read access.
4) Data residency: us-west-2 only.

Given the HSM requirement + the long retention WORM logs, it sounds like Private is the path we expect. That said, we are open to a Dedicated approach only if Redwood can meet the HSM requirement in-network (i.e., Dedicated nodes in our VPC with CloudHSM attached to those instances and logs written directly to our S3). Is that something you support for Dedicated?

Procurement asked for: a) a high-level Statement of Work for a Private deployment and b) cost bands for Dedicated (1yr reserved) vs Private (annual license + infra).

We can do a technical call Wed 26 Aug, 10:00–10:45 PT. Security will join (David Rao). Please send calendar invite.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Platform Security | Aeon Health
maya@aeonhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@aeonhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@aeonhealth.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AEON Health: follow-up on SSO / KMS / log retention & deployment recommendation

Maya / team — great, appreciate the clarity. Quick replies inline and proposed next steps.

Inline: 
- Dedicated + CloudHSM in-customer-VPC: supported. We offer a Dedicated topology where Redwood-managed serving nodes are provisioned in your AWS account/VPC and attach to your CloudHSM cluster. That satisfies HSM-backed key control and keeps KMS in your account.
- Logging WORM to your S3: supported for both Dedicated (direct write from nodes in your VPC) and Private; we can sign a log retention SLA and provide signed receipts for ingestion. The 7-year retention and WORM policy are operationally acceptable.
- SSO/SCIM: supported; our SCIM connector can be configured to provision Redwood Console users in your Okta tenant.

Recommendation & path: 
- If procurement timeline is tight and you want to move quickly: run a Dedicated PoC in your AWS account. It will validate latency, throughput, integration with CloudHSM, and the logging pipeline within ~4 weeks. Deliverables: PoC environment in us-west-2, sample workloads, integration docs, and a handoff checklist.
- If you require full air-gapped or on-prem controls beyond CloudHSM-in-VPC (e.g., private control plane), then Private is the right long-term path; we’ll scope an on-prem package and a longer rollout.

Action items I will take this week: 
1) Send calendar invite for Wed 26 Aug, 10:00 PT (including a short agenda + security checklist row owners).
2) Share two SOW templates: Dedicated-PoC and Private-Deployment (high-level cost bands).
3) Copy of our CloudHSM integration doc and logging ingestion spec (I’ll attach in a follow-up).

Lauren / Marcus — can you please prepare the Dedicated-PoC SOW draft and an initial 1yr pricing band so procurement has something to review at the Wed call?

Maya — if Procurement prefers DocuSign ahead of the call, happy to surface a preliminary PoC scoping agreement.

Best,
Ben Carter
